# Rule

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Rule>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The abstract base of a deontic rule in a rights statement — it binds a regulated [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) to an optional target asset and assignee. Specialised by [`gmeow:Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md), [`gmeow:Prohibition`](gmeow-Prohibition.md) and [`gmeow:Duty`](gmeow-Duty.md) (the ODRL rule trio).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Norm`](gmeow-Norm.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the abstract base only when reasoning over any deontic rule regardless of polarity; for a concrete rule mint the specific kind — [`gmeow:Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md), [`gmeow:Prohibition`](gmeow-Prohibition.md), or [`gmeow:Duty`](gmeow-Duty.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid typing an instance as a bare [`gmeow:Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md) (the three concrete kinds are pairwise disjoint and always apply) and avoid encoding the regulated action as a rule subclass — the action is an open [`gmeow:RightsAction`](gmeow-RightsAction.md) value.

### How to use

- Type a rule as [`Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md)/Prohibition/Duty, give it exactly one [`gmeow:ruleAction`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAction.md), and add [`gmeow:ruleTarget`](../properties/gmeow-ruleTarget.md), [`gmeow:ruleAssignee`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAssignee.md), and [`gmeow:ruleConstraint`](../properties/gmeow-ruleConstraint.md) as needed; the base [`Rule`](gmeow-Rule.md) axiom guarantees every rule names an action.

### Examples

- ex:rule a [`gmeow:Permission`](gmeow-Permission.md); [`gmeow:ruleAction`](../properties/gmeow-ruleAction.md) [`gmeow:actionUse`](../individuals/gmeow-actionUse.md).
